name: Revivify
body:
Design creation (healing); Level 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This script creates healing power, even bringing a recently slain creature back to life. This functions as a breath of life spell, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, it heals an additional 1d8 hit points, and can bring back a creature that died 1 round earlier (up to 5 rounds).
